title: Rules
description: Set your trading discipline and spot portfolio limits with a clear head.
limits.title: Account limits
limits.description: Percentages are of the account value.
limits.totalOpenRisk.hint: The most you can lose if every stop triggers together.
limits.dailyLoss.hint: New orders are blocked for the rest of the day once reached.
limits.cautionAt: Caution starts at, % of a limit
classes.title: Coin class rules
classes.description: System defaults set by the server. Stop distance is the ATR multiplier times daily movement. The allocation cap applies to spot holdings only, not to futures.
classes.scrollLabel: Coin class rules, scroll horizontally to see all columns
classes.large.who: Other coins with at least 10M USDT average daily volume
classes.small.who: Coins below that volume, or with unknown volume
classes.stable.who: USDC, FDUSD and other named stablecoins
discipline.title: Discipline rules
discipline.description: Promises you make to yourself. Metron either blocks the order or warns and records it.
discipline.cooldown.name: Cooldown after a loss
discipline.cooldown.detail: No new order for {n0} minutes after a position closes at a loss.
discipline.hours.name: No orders after {n0}
discipline.hours.detail: No new order between {n0} and {n1} UTC.
discipline.stop.name: A stop is never widened
discipline.stop.detail: A stop can move toward the price, never away from it.
discipline.footer: A rule cannot be loosened while it is counting down or within an hour of a loss.
defaults: Discipline defaults: 2% risk per trade; 6% total open risk; 5 open positions; 3 losing trades per day; 5% daily loss cap; 5 stopped trades per week; 10% weekly loss cap.
noAccounts: Create a USDT account to configure limits.
validationHint: Use a decimal point and up to 8 decimal places. Percentages and target risk/reward must be greater than 0 and at most 100; counts must be positive whole numbers.
invalidDecimal: Enter a value greater than 0 and at most 100, with up to 8 decimal places.
invalidCount: Enter a whole number from 1 to 4,294,967,295.
